A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (21 April 2022). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998) with one change: it is reworded: “use 1 Force to target an adjacent site where opponent has no presence. All your characters present in battle move away (for free) to the target site. The battle is canceled.”.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-fallback-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Fall Back! (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in place of “E”. The game text reads: “If opponent just initiated a battle at an exterior site with more than double your total power, use 1 Force to target an adjacent site where opponent has no presence. All your characters present in battle move away (for free) to the target site. The battle is canceled.” (it is reworded: “use 1 Force to target an adjacent site where opponent has no presence. All your characters present in battle move away (for free) to the target site. The battle is canceled.”).

The whole 2018 image and the whole D-E1 image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
